name: Glimmora

abilities.name: Shattering Crystal
abilities.text: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can’t get any points for it.

attacks.name: Venomous Hit
attacks.text: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavor:
Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized
poison energy. It has recently become evident
that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
